## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Is the EA free?
A: Yes, 100% free with our partner broker. No deposit required to start, minimum $100 to activate.

Q: Do I need trading experience?
A: No. The EA is fully automated. Install it, set your risk level, and let it run.

Q: Which broker do I need to use?
A: We work with one regulated partner broker. The EA works on any MT5 account but free license requires funding with our partner.

Q: Are there hidden costs?
A: No hidden costs. No monthly fees, no subscriptions, no commissions on trades.

Q: How do I install the EA?
A: 5 minutes: download .ex5 → open MT5 Data Folder → paste into MQL5/Experts → restart MT5 → enable AutoTrading → drag EA onto chart.

Q: Can I test before purchasing?
A: Yes. Free demo license for MT5 demo accounts. We recommend 2-4 weeks demo before going live.
